Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/php-src && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_replace_exec","line":1040,"var":"arg_pattern","code":"zend_parse_parameters() reads the attacker-controlled regex pattern string","note":"The exploit input is the regex pattern supplied by the caller."},
  {"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_replace_exec","line":1077,"var":"re","code":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, options, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax)","note":"The pattern is compiled into an Oniguruma regex object, building the internal AST used by the engine."},
  {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":7035,"var":"root","code":"r = tune_tree(root, reg, 0, &scan_env);","note":"Compilation recursively walks the regex tree and reaches quantifier nodes that need tuning."},
  {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5441,"var":"node","code":"static int tune_quant(Node* node, regex_t* reg, int state, ScanEnv* env)","note":"Quantifier nodes are processed during tuning; their body pointer is examined and the node state is updated."},
  {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"For empty-or-repeating bodies, the compiler computes the body emptiness classification before continuing."},
  {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This helper recursively inspects the quantifier body and follows list/alt/quantifier/bag children."},
  {"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4947,"var":"en->te.Then","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(en->te.Then);","note":"When the body contains conditionals, the helper descends into both branches, reusing node references from the regex tree."},
  {"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4953,"var":"en->te.Else","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(en->te.Else);","note":"The same recursive walk reaches the alternate branch, exercising the stale node reference path after prior tuning/freeing activity."},
  {"step":9,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4969,"var":"return r","code":"return r;","note":"The helper returns the computed emptiness classification to the caller, completing the vulnerable traversal that leads to the use-after-free read observed in ASAN."}
]
